verdict.rationale: Stale-flag detection and code references are a fair axis for a feature-flag platform, but the evidence pack never documents stale or lifecycle flag detection, code-reference scanning, or any cleanup workflow. Tags, the protected marker, audit logs and Admin API deletion are adjacent features or building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can find stale flags and code references so temporary flags actually get removed from the codebase
